notes.title: Patch Notes. 27.04.2024
notes.notes:
Hey!

Today's update includes some bug fixes and improvements in general.

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]

--> Fixed an error where the Highly Necklace of War would have the same stat bonus as its predecessor, Higher Necklace of War.
It now has an increase of +7 ATK instead of only +4.

--> The description of Fyrea's arte "Wildifre" didn't make it clear enough that it hits all enemies on the field.
This has now been resolved.

--> The description of the item "Ysenta's Leather Rip" did not show the correct text. This has been fixed.

--> Fixed an error where the item "Story of Ilyatir II" didn't show its content.

--> Some buff items increased the stats of each character by the wrong amount. Now, the buff amount is applied correctly.

--> Some items were incorrectly marked as "Key Items". The issue has been resolved.

--> The Platinum Scale Gloves had the wrong category. Now, they can be equipped as gloves instead of armor.

--> While having the "Protectun Ring" equipped, on rare occasions upon using a buff arte on the specific character, it would trigger the ring's counter effect. This has now been resolved.

--> The necklace "Critical Eye" stated that it gives a +35% critical hit rate increase to the characters it has been equipped to. This works now.

--> The "Magical Snake Skin Armor" of Limare accidentally increased her EP by an outrageous amount. This has now been corrected.

--> In some areas, certain monsters were blocked off due to mapping errors. This has now been fixed.

--> When Fyrea is supposed to explore the Eastern Desert, the NPC Mon'gra incorrectly tells her to go to the Temple of Flames upon interaction (which has already been done at this point). This has now been corrected.

--> Certain item vendors (other than the one in Flayk) didn't feel like showing their entire stock when trying to buy something. This should now work as intended.

--> After triggering a certain cutscene in Dorrenta, the mini-map would disable itself. This has been fixed.

--> Fixed an error where a certain cutscene in Dorrenta would tell the player that new bounty quests are available, even though this wasn't the case.

--> The "Merchant Lantern" didn't work as intended. However, this issue should've been resolved now.

--> Fixed some teleportation issues in a certain area later in the game.

--> Upon completing a certain dungeon in the later part of the game, a bug would occur that disables the player's visible party members on the map. This issue has been addressed.

--> After a certain event is triggered, using the "Emergency Teleport" items would change the screen color back to default. This shouldn't happen anymore.

--> Fixed a bug where a certain NPC would simply vanish upon talking to her. This issue has been resolved.

--> Fixed a typo where during a certain cutscene, the party should've been rewarded with a banquet, and not a bouquet. Now Fyrea and her friends are able to enjoy their meal.

--> Fixed an error where the rewards for the bounty quest "Cave Guardian" could be obtained an indefinite number of times. This is fixed now.

--> The description of a certain character's distribution attributes was written in German. This has now been corrected to English.

--> Fixed a bug where too many recipes were displayed in the crafting log. The log should now show the correct number of unlockable recipes.

--> Fixed an error where the "Orb of Lyghte" couldn't be obtained by opening the respective chest.

--> The items "Demonic Key" and "Strange Key" can now be used to open certain chests in a certain area.

--> Some crafting materials have been missing. These can now be obtained in the following ways:

Water Powder: By defeating the monsters "Aquatic Slime", and "Spirit of Ice".

Gold Ore: Can be gathered in the following areas: "Western Cave", and "Western Cave: Inner".

Tsuyoblume: This one can be gathered in the "Star Oasis" area.

Enlightened Stone: By defeating the following monsters: "Veil of Earth".

Ghost's Essence: By defeating the following monsters: "Horrific Ghost".

Redflame Stone: By defeating the following monsters: "Burn-Marked Mimic", and "Ashen Guardian". (Removed the "Lava Stone" material from their drop pools.)

--> Fixed an error where certain recipes wouldn't show in the "Special" category when buying from a vendor.


[u][b]General improvements:[/b][/u]

--> Raised the max level of each character from 135 -> 225.

--> Implemented a dedicated tutorial for the distribution system.

notes.title: Patch Notes 07.04.2024

Adivsor's House,  Shrine of Ilyatir, Tenebra's Throne Room.

[u][b]--- General ---[/b][/u]

2. ---> Your characters now fully restore their LE and EP upon level up.
3. ---> Added enhanced visual effects to most of the existing artes.
4. ---> Reworked some area maps.
5. ---> Overhauled the minimap system.

notes.title: Patch Notes 21.09.20

21.09.2020

[u][b]--- Content ---[/b][/u]
1. ---> Added a new quest type to the game : "Synthesis".
2. ---> Added new synthesis quests that will get you started and guide you through the synthesis system.
3. ---> Added new areas to the game : "Mountain Cave C", "Mountain Cave C (F2)", "Mountain Cave C (F3)", "Frozen Cave".

[u][b]--- Character ---[/b][/u]
1. ---> Added a new extra character to the game : "Saphira".

[b][u]--- Enemies ---[/u][/b]
1. ---> Added a new enemy to the area "Mountain Cave A" : "Fallen Demon Knight".
2. ---> Added a new enemy to the area "Mountain Cave B" : "Fallen Demon Knight".
3. ---> Added 2 new enemies to the "Mountain Cave C" dungeon complex : "Terrormare", "Horrific Ghost".

[b][u]--- Balancing ---[/u][/b]
1. ---> Added the "Guard Point" system to the game : The GP system consists out of artes or items that will grant the user (or his allies) the "Guard" state. Once a character has some guard points stacked up, all damage that would've been done to his LE, are first dealt to the existing guard points. For example : If a character with 200 guard points is receiving damage lower or equal to that amount, it will just reduce the existing guard points.
2. ---> Reduced the needed WP for Fyrea's arte "Phantom's Rage" : 80 -> 60.
3 ---> Changed the ressource cost of Fyrea's arte "Life Leeching Slash" : 55 WP -> 360 EP.
4. ---> Reduced the needed WP of Fyrea's arte "Throat Slice" : 35 -> 25.
5. ---> Reduced the needed WP of Fyrea's arte "Assassination" on all levels by 5, except for "Assassination III" - for that arte, the WP were reduced by 10.
6. ---> Increased the gain of WP after using Fyrea's arte "Dagger Stab". (These changes apply to all levels of "Dagger Stab".)
7. ---> Increased the gain of WP after using Fyrea's arte "Lucky Hitting" : 0 -> 20.
8. ---> Increased the gain of WP after using Fyrea's arte "Wildfire" : 0 -> 25. (All other levels of "Wildfire" will increase the WP gain by another +5).
9. ---> Reduced the needed WP of Fyrea's arte "Raging Stabs" : 45 -> 35. (These changes apply to all levels of "Raging Stabs").
10. ---> Increased the gain of WP after using Fyrea's arte "Fiery Wrath" : 0 -> 25. (All other levels of "Fiery Wrath" will increase the WP gain by another +10).
11. ---> Increased the gain of WP after using Fyrea's arte "Feyrunten's Fiery Claw" : 0 -> 40.
12. ---> Increased the gain op WP after using Aaron's arte "Blade of Erdun" : 5 -> 10. (These changes apply to all levels of "Blade of Erdun").
13. ---> Increased the gain of WP after using Aaron's arte "Boulder" : 8 -> 15. (These changes apply to all levels of "Boulder").
14. ---> Reduced the needed WP for Aaron's arte "Brutality of Erdun" : 20 -> 15. (These changes apply to all levels of "Brutality of Erdun").
15. ---> Increased the gain of WP after using Aaron's arte "Dragon Knight's Protection" : 20 -> 35.
16. ---> Increased the gain of WP after using Alissa's arte "Fast Arrow" : 5 -> 10 (All other levels of "Fast Arrow" will increase the WP gain by another +5).
17. ---> Increased the gain of WP after using Alissa's arte "Mobility" : 10 -> 20.
18. ---> Reduced the needed WP of Alissa's arte "Volley of Wynd" : 20 -> 10. (These changes apply to all levels of "Volley of Wynd").
19. ---> Increased the gain of WP after using Alissa's arte "Bow Mastery" : 15 -> 30.
20. ---> Reduced the needed WP for Alissa's arte "Paralyzing Arrow" : 15 -> 5. (These changes apply to all levels of "Paralyzing Arrow").
21. ---> Reduced the needed WP for Alissa's arte "Destructive Shot" : 35 -> 25.
22. ---> Reduced the needed WP for Alissa's arte "Wyndar's Heavy Storm" : 45 -> 0.
23. ---> Increased the gain of WP after using Alissa's arte "Wyndar's Heavy Storm" : 0 -> 45.
24. ---> Reduced the needed WP for Alissa's arte "Stormy Claw" : 60 -> 45.
25. ---> Now, after battle the WP won't reset anymore. If you had 30 WP after winning a battle, those WP will  now be saved up for the next battle and can be used freely.

[u][b]--- Artes ---[/b][/u]
1. ---> Added  new artes for Fyrea to the game : "Burning Barrier", "Burning Barrier II",
2. ---> Changed the level requirement for learning Fyrea's arte "Assassination" : 13 -> 9.
3. ---> Changed the level requirement for learning Fyrea's arte "Assassination II" : 19 -> 14.

[b][u]--- General ---[/u][/b]
1. ---> Increased the maximum mastery level for artes : 30 -> 50.
2. ---> Re-balanced some bounty quests and dungeon quests : Now, you need to kill less monsters in order to complete some of those quests. This change was made in order to reduce the feeling of unnecessary grinding.

[u][b]--- Items ---[/b][/u]
1. ---> Added rew recipes to the game : "Recipe : Orcanic Dagger" (this one can only be obtained through the synthesis tutorial quests), "Recipe : Fallen Knight's Shield".
2. ---> Added a new material to the game : "Knight Shield Fragment"

[b][u]--- Armor ---[/u][/b]

[u][b]--- Weapons ---[/b][/u]

2. ---> Added a new weapon type to the game : "Glacyal Scepter".


[b][u]-- Other ---[/u][/b]
1. ---> Highlighted most of interactive objects in order to make them more visible.
2. ---> Implemented a day and night cycle.
3. ---> Added footstep sounds while walking.
4. ---> Added sound effects to all the balloon symbols that are bound to pop up. (Story, interacting with objects, side story, etc.)

---> The Challenge Tower will be implemented in the next update instead!

notes.title: Patch Notes 23.08.20
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this month's patch notes, I implemented some new artes, armor parts,
enemies as well as fierce enemies and a lot of other stuff!



[u][b]--- Enemies ---[/b][/u]
1. ---> Added new normal monsters to the game : "Sandy Snake"
2. ---> Added new fierce monsters to the game : "Fierce Earth Gargoyle"

[u][b]--- Balancing ---[/b][/u]

[u][b]--- Artes ---[/b][/u]

2. ---> Added a new arte for Fyrea to the game : "Feyrunten's Fiery Claw" which is the direct follow up arte for "Fiery Wrath".

Now, artes like "Dagger Stab" will be automatically forgotten once you learned a highter tier of that arte, such like "Dagger Stab II". notes.title: Patch Notes 21.07.2020
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

In today's update a lot of stuff has been implemented and changed.
Especiallythe equipment system has been completely overhauled and
a lot of new equipment has been added to the game.
Even a new type of monsters has been added along with special
equipment and artes you can only get by defeating those foes.


[u][b]--- Content ---[/b][/u]

1. ---> Added a new group of enemies, called "Fierce Monsters", to the game. Those are very strong and dangerous foes. They will appear once you've slain a certain number of certain normal monsters (such like the Flaming Willowisps in the Burning Cave) and yield a lot more EXP and "D" than normal monsters. Additionally, they also can drop unique equipment you wouldn't get anywhere else in the game. Each set of equipment has special states they can apply to your group or to an enemy that resembles the "Fierce Monster" you've obtained it from. You can even obtain new artes from those monsters!

[u][b]--- Character ---[/b][/u]

1. ---> Added a new character called "Bresk" to the game. Bresk can be obtained through a special quest chain that you have to complete once you trigger him to appear. He is using a recently implemented weapon type and has been assigned a newly created class.


[u][b]--- Enemies---[/b][/u]

1. ---> Overhauled the drop pool for most enemies due to the implementation of new armor types,  weapon types and materials.


[u][b]--- Balancing---[/b][/u]

1. ---> Added an active level scaling to most enemies. Means, if your characters grow stronger in level, the enemies will do the same and increase their own stats up to a certain max amount. But since those monsters will pose an even greater threat for your group while leveling up, they also yield more EXP and Daranen - or short "D" - for every level up they gain.

2. ---> Added a difficulty slider to the settings in the game menu. With that you can adjust the power of the enemies you'll encounter. The setting levels are : 100% (default), 200% (hard), 300% (extreme) and 400% (deadly). The percentages determine the growth in stats of enemies encountered by exactly  100% per setting level. So if you want to step up your game, then now you can do so! Also, the setting level can be adjusted as you see fit without limitations. Meaning, you won't be locked in the harder difficulty if you decide to try it out.
---> Take note that I will observe those changes and re-balance them if necessary.


[u][b]--- Artes---[/b][/u]

1. ---> Added a new category of arte books, called "Fierce Artes", to the game. These artes can be obtained by defeating  certain fierce monsters. They are powerful and are resembling special attributes of the fierce monster they were obtained from.

2. ---> Added a new arte for Fyrea to the game : "(Fierce) : Demonic Flame".


[u][b]--- Armor---[/b][/u]

1. ---> Added new armor categories to the database : "Dragonic Armor", "Dragonic Gloves", "Dragon Scale Armor", "Dragon Scale Gloves", "Heavy Armor", "Heavy Gloves"

2. ---> Overhauled most of the existing armor types such as : "Leather Armor", "Leather Gloves", "Magical Armor", "Magical Gloves", "Shields" ; all previously existing items of these categories have been replaced and improved. Also the total amount of these items have increased, meaning there are now much more different items of a specific armor type available through buying in a shop and crafting.

3. ---> Changed the stats of "Ysenta's Gloves" : Physical Attack 9 -> 19 (These change was made due to the overhaul of the equipment system and to keep those gloves special.)

4. --->  Changed the stats of "Bloodstained Gloves" : Physical Attack 20 -> 30, Magical Attack 15 -> 25 (These changes were made due to the overhaul of the equipment system and to keep those gloves special.)

5. ---> Increased the defensive stats of "Fyrea's Armor" at all levels in order to keep up to the recent changes in the equipment system and the enemies.

6. ---> Added some new armors to the game : "Fierce Chimera's Scaled Gloves", "Fierce Chimera's Leather Gloves",  "Fierce Runic Demon's Ring", "Fierce Stone  Golem's Necklace".


[u][b]--- Weapon---[/b][/u]

1. ---> Added a new weapon categorie to the game : "Spear"

2. ---> Overhauled the weapon category "Magical Wand" : Replaced nearly every available weapon of that category and increased its total amount.

3. ---> Increased the stats of Fyrea's guardian daggers "Flaren" and "Feyruen" in order to keep up with the equipment overhaul and keep them special.

4. ---> Added some new weapons to the game : "Fierce Chimera's Tooth", "Fierce Demon's Spear", "Fierce Golem's Bow".


[u][b]--- Items---[/b][/u]

1. ---> Added a whole bunch of new materials to the game.

2. ---> Overhauled the collectable materials all over  the world map. Far more materials are now waiting to be collected and to be crafted into powerful equipment!

3. ---> Added a new arte book to the game : "(Fierce) : Demonic Flame".


[u][b]--- General---[/b][/u]

1. ---> Added a color code to every item,  weapon and armor. This color code will help you determine whether this item is something special or not : Yellow -> Common item. Green -> Uncommon item (mostly crafted). Blue -> Special item (mostly dropped). Orange -> Very rare item (mostly dropped). Red -> Epic item (mostly dropped/crafted). Purple -> Legendary item.

2. ---> Added the possibillity to equip multiple armor  types for specific characters : Aaron & Alissa ; added the new armor type "Dragonic Gloves", "Dragonic Armor" to the allowed equipment pool. Fyrea : added the new armor type "Dragon Scale Gloves" to the allowed equipment pool.
